title: The Day of the Soggy Daydream
skyStory: The moon dives into Pisces this morning, a thirteen percent sliver doing slow backstrokes through the dreamiest sign of all. Pisces does not believe in schedules. Pisces believes in vibes, puddles and the deep meaning of fog. Saturn has posted a sign that says No Daydreaming During Work Hours. Pisces has already floated past it, humming.

reading: You will drift off in the middle of something important today, maybe a meeting, maybe a spreadsheet, and come back with a fully formed idea that has nothing to do with anything. Write it down before it swims away. Pisces ideas are slippery and gorgeous, like a fish wearing a scarf.

Around 3:30 pm the [[Page of Cups]] pops up with a little fish peeking out of its cup, which is to say something unexpected and charming lands in your inbox. Do not make it a project. Not everything has to become a project, Tiger. Some things are just there to make you smile.
joel.mission: Write down the strangest daydream you have today in exactly one sentence and send it to Nancy without context.
joel.omen: A puddle reflecting the sky perfectly. It means your intuition is right about something you have been second-guessing.

reading: Pisces is a water sign and you are a shore person, so today the two of you get along famously. Fog may roll in, literal or otherwise. Do not fight it. Some of your best thinking happens when you cannot see more than ten feet ahead.

Your hands will do something lovely today: tell a story to someone who needs it, or help someone finally figure out a tool they have been wrestling with. Watch their face change when it clicks. That is your favourite thing in the world, and the [[Three of Pentacles]] knows it. Count how many times you see it before bedtime.
nancy.mission: Help one person figure out one thing today, then ask them to explain it back to you in their own words.
nancy.omen: Fog rolling in off the water around dusk. It means the answer you need is closer than it looks.

together.text: Swap your strangest daydreams of the day, one sentence each, no explaining. Then each of you writes the next sentence of the other's dream. Pisces will be thrilled. Saturn will pretend not to read it, then read it twice.
